scope: Self-contained transparent garment SVG using the same validated vector renderer; no photo, placement, note or app-data embedding.
checks: Real SVG download, MIME/filename and native XML parsing/title escaping/internal references.
Whole decoded raster SHA-256 equality against PNG for plain/stripe/weave plus separate literal red/green/transparent landmark expectations.
Maximum100-path/12000-point vector download and PNG raster equivalence, exact unchanged project backup.
Keyboard download cancels a live captured gesture and keeps redo plus exact committed backup.
390px viewport download without horizontal overflow, external requests or page errors.
limits: Complete-image equality compares shared renderer outputs; independent artwork correctness is established at selected literal pixels, not independently for every pixel.
Native browser checks were run in GitHub CI; no local native Chromium result is claimed.
SVG is not an app backup, sewing pattern or physical-size/fit simulation. SVG import and arbitrary SVG editing are not added.
